Team7 reports record-specific net1 comparisons for source edge ordinals 120–139 near BG, BF, BE, BD, BC, BB and BH. Each has a reported ordered-coordinate match in the selected model, not electrical identity. Earlier component, chain, body and route views overlap every crop; these are not unseen pixels. D12 captions, paired dashed paths, bands, diamonds, small white gaps and worn ink are recorded. A thin descender near BD remains unassigned; no missing wire or join is inferred. The packet inventory lists 159 distinct net1 ordinals of 572 raw records, including 149 previously listed; earlier entries were not independently re-audited and this is not electrical clearance. Approximate registration leaves edge mapping, gap attribution, terminal attachment, crossing ownership and continuity unresolved. Net1 remains incomplete; historical net0 edge0 was not independently re-audited. QP/QP1, net62 186–187, identity, electrical and page-wide omission holds persist.

Three native crops were independently viewed. All earlier caption, net0/1, thin-mark, net62 and omission holds persist.
